extracted.summary: A solicitor enquires about funding of around £47,000 for her client's costs to final hearing in financial remedy proceedings at the Family Court at Manchester, where matrimonial assets are about £250,500 and an FDR is listed for 9 October 2026.
extracted.draft_reply: Thank you for your enquiry on behalf of your client, which we have received and logged. To take this further we would need confirmation of your client's identity and address details, a breakdown of the estimated costs to final hearing, details of the matrimonial assets and any existing charges or encumbrances over them, and confirmation of the position on disclosure and the current procedural timetable. It would also help to have your firm's details and confirmation of who would be responsible for the retainer. Once we have reviewed that information, a member of the team will come back to you. Please note that nothing in this message constitutes an offer of funding or any indication of terms.
